points: Supreme Court sided with Republicans to reject student IDs for voting in New Hampshire.
Decision cites rule against altering election rules close to election day.
Voting rights advocates argue the directive will disenfranchise young and low-income voters.

summaries.summary: Lewis Hamilton plans to extend his Formula One career into the early 2030s to participate in the African Grand Prix in Rwanda.
points: Hamilton aims to race in Africa despite Rwanda's human rights criticism.
Rwanda to host the African Grand Prix in the early 2030s on a new circuit.
Last F1 race in Africa was in South Africa in 1993.

summaries.summary: Researchers announced they hacked the iPhone and demonstrated their findings at Hexacon in Paris.
points: Demonstrations were revealed at Hexacon in Paris.
Focus on iMessage highlighted over third-party apps.
Release of details pending.

summaries.summary: eMudhra faced a private key compromise of 8 intermediate certificates, leading to distrust and revocation by major tech companies.
points: 8 eMudhra Intermediate certificates had their private keys compromised.
Mozilla independently recovered the keys, confirming a flawed key generation process.
6 TLS certificates and 2 codesigning certificates were affected, with 6 revoked by eMudhra.

summaries.summary: Most software performance issues stem from poor design rather than the use of slower programming languages.
points: Software performance is typically constrained by I/O operations, not the language speed.
Rewriting a Python program in C can only improve performance by up to 1.5x due to I/O bottlenecks.
Significant speedups usually come from redesigning software to reduce workload, not from language changes.

summaries.summary: Netanyahu orders large-scale military operation in West Bank following the deaths of two Israeli soldiers and two Palestinians.
summaries.significance: Netanyahu's order for a large-scale operation in the West Bank escalates tensions before upcoming elections.
points: Netanyahu orders military to conduct house-to-house searches and demolish homes.
Incident occurred near Hebron after Israeli military claimed to thwart a "terror attack."
Operation is described as the largest in the West Bank in decades.

summaries.summary: Europe columnists discuss the causes and implications of recent protests in France.
points: Columnists argue protests stem from local grievances rather than foreign instigation.
Russia and US far right are exploiting social media to fuel division and anger.
